cd = load("coding")
cats = list(range(-2, 3)); k = len(cats)
idx = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(cats)}
W = np.array([[1 - ((cats[i] - cats[j]) / (k - 1))**2 for j in range(k)] for i in range(k)])

def weighted_kappa(x, y):
    O = np.zeros((k, k))
    for a, b in zip(x, y):
        O[idx[a], idx[b]] += 1          # 두 코더의 판정을 교차표로
    O /= O.sum()
    E = np.outer(O.sum(1), O.sum(0))     # 우연히 그렇게 될 몫
    return (np.sum(W * O) - np.sum(W * E)) / (1 - np.sum(W * E))

for t, name in [("p", "주인공"), ("s", "전환"), ("q", "소명"), ("a", "조력자"),
                ("c", "시련"), ("t", "변형"), ("l", "유산")]:
    print(name, round(weighted_kappa(cd[f"coder1_{t}"].values, cd[f"coder2_{t}"].values), 2))
